fusions.name: Clamp and Gnaw
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 3 tiles away and clamps on for 13 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stunning it for 1.2 seconds. The gnawing leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Culvert Ambush
fusions.desc: Lunges up out of cover at every enemy within 3 tiles for 26 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Eyes Above the Waterline
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later and you move 22% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Teeth That Keep Growing
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour, and you regain 0.4 health a second.
